note: Selectors and guards the #94 stills check should enforce on the built #98 view (app side), after D-20261018-198: the bar carries only the ordering parts (how they look + Heat, or how they look alone if Heat fails #96); resume, schedule strength and quality of wins are context beside it. Guard ids match check-comps.mjs; the comp-side twin proves each guard with a planted fixture (planted/). Fields marked (#105) are the ones #105 adds; the view must read them, not derive them.

targets.name: board
targets.assert: present; columns Rank/Team/Conference/Record/Resume/Δ/TR+; Resume is new (header 'Resume', title + aria-description 'Who they beat, ranked.'); rows ordered by the ordering TR+, never by resume

targets.name: board-row
targets.assert: one per ranked team in rank order

targets.name: row-toggle
targets.assert: button, aria-expanded true|false, aria-controls → panel id, aria-label == 'Show why {Team} is #{rank}', ≥44×44, :focus-visible outline ≥2px

targets.name: why-panel
targets.assert: data-state in open|negative|heat|loading|error; data-parts == parts.length (2 with Heat, 1 without)

targets.name: cmp-above
targets.assert: data-gap == team ordering TR+ − above ordering TR+; data-parts == parts.length; caption 'Why they trail #{rank_above} {TeamAbove}'; data-empty=true for rank 1

targets.name: cmp-below
targets.assert: data-gap == team − below (ordering TR+); caption 'Why they lead #{rank_below} {TeamBelow}'; data-empty=true for the last ranked team

targets.name: part
targets.assert: one per ORDERING part in parts[] order (strength, heat); data-weight == parts[].weight from the ordering config (ADR 0002, not literals); data-contribution == weight × (value_self − value_other); visible [data-part-label] == locked part.name.<key> ('how they look', 'Heat')

targets.name: chips
targets.assert: one per game; data-tag in quality_win|cupcake|bad_loss|none (#105 tag); data-venue in home|away|neutral (#105 venue); opponent_rank shown when ranked

targets.name: stat-sos
targets.assert: outside every [data-gap]; label 'Schedule strength', value '#{sos_rank} of {N} (1 = hardest)' (#105)

targets.name: stat-sov
targets.assert: outside every [data-gap]; label 'Quality of wins', value '#{sov_rank} of {N} (1 = best)' (#105)

targets.name: delta
targets.assert: == team.prev_rank − team.rank (#105 prev_rank); '—' when prev_rank is null

targets.name: few-games
targets.assert: present iff games_played < threshold (threshold: open question, comps use 4)

targets.name: share-btn
targets.assert: ≥44×44; label 'Share'; shares the 1200×675 image only (no URL, no post text) until the domain is picked

targets.name: share-card
targets.assert: exactly 1200×675; every visible string is locked copy or data (headline '{Team} is #{rank} on TR+.', brand name, tagline); image-only: no URL and no post text until Michael picks the domain; role=img with aria-label == share.card.alt_text

targets.name: sheet
targets.assert: 390 only: role=dialog, aria-modal, full width, close button ≥44×44

targets.name: resume-cell
targets.assert: text == '#{resume_rank}'; title and aria-label == 'Resume: #{resume_rank} of {N}. Who they beat, ranked.' (N = board size); resume_rank from #105 (rank by record_score); context only

targets.name: context
targets.assert: beside the comparisons, not inside a [data-gap]; holds ctx-resume ('#{n} of {N} (1 = best)'), stat-sos, stat-sov and (2-part only) recent

targets.name: recent
targets.assert: 2-part only: 'Last {k} games: {wins}-{losses}.' from games over the Heat window

guards.rule: |Σ data-contribution − data-gap| ≤ 1e-9 per comparison, where the gap is the ORDERING TR+ gap and the parts are only the ordering parts; every shown number is the 1-dp rounding of its data
every [data-part] has a visible label (app: strict, no pending labels)
documentElement.scrollWidth ≤ 390 and no element outside a scroll container crosses the viewport
every button, a[href], [role=button], input, select, [tabindex≥0] is ≥44×44
row toggle reached by Tab matches :focus-visible and shows outline ≥2px (or box-shadow)

case-insensitive word match on text, alt/aria-label/aria-description/title/placeholder/content/data-url/value and title: bet(s)|betting|bettor(s)|odds|market(s)|spread(s)|line(s)|pick(s)|lock(s)|lock of the week|cover(s/ed)|projection(s)|projected (Phil's betting check adds lock/cover/projection)
unlocked slots render no text; locked/existing slots verbatim, with {fields} filled only from data (data-vars) in text and attributes (data-aslot); no lorem/placeholder/TBD/{{ }}
computed colours ⊂ tokens.json (team data colours exempt via [data-team-color])
card and document exactly 1200×675; both PNGs 1200×675; no unlocked text: every visible string sits in a locked/existing [data-slot] or a [data-field] (URL not required, and absent while unlocked)
no literal weights in renderer source (old 0.80/0.15/0.05 and illustrative 0.9/0.1); rendered data-weight ∈ parts[] for the state

each state carries its required selectors (#1 empty above, last empty below, ≥1 negative part); every comparison renders parts_count parts (2 or 1); context never inside a gap; Heat state shows Heat deciding a comparison
